title: ICAB IT Practical Labs
body: The Institute of Chartered Accountants of Bangladesh (ICAB)
summary: Mandatory hands-on practical IT training sessions administered by the ICAB IT Training Centre across Certificate and Professional levels. Covers enterprise accounting software, advanced financial modeling, business intelligence, cybersecurity forensics, and banking CAATs audit interrogation.

all.name: Complete IT Curriculum (5 Labs)
all.blurb: Complete ICAB practical IT training curriculum spanning Certificate Level and Professional Level hands-on competencies.

stages.title: Certificate Level Practical Workshops
stages.subtitle: Foundational software implementation & advanced spreadsheet engineering (2 Labs)

nodes.name: Accounting Software Implementation (QuickBooks / Sage / ERP)
competencies: Requirements analysis & Chart of Accounts (COA) multi-tier configuration
General Ledger, Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable & statutory tax setup
Legacy data migration, trial balance reconciliation & rollback planning
User Acceptance Testing (UAT) & post-implementation IS audit review
checklists: Define business requirements, user roles, and system prerequisites
Configure company file, fiscal calendar, currency, and multi-tier COA
Set up AR, AP, General Ledger, bank feeds, and statutory tax parameters
Import sample legacy data (CSV/Excel), execute trial balance balance-checks, and model rollback plans
Conduct User Acceptance Testing (UAT), verify audit trails, and execute post-implementation IS audit review
nodes.description: Hands-on configuration and end-to-end implementation of commercial accounting software and enterprise ERP systems. Covers business requirements mapping, Chart of Accounts architecture, transaction cycle setup, legacy data migration, and post-implementation review.

nodes.name: Applied Excel for Professional Accountants
competencies: Dynamic array architecture: XLOOKUP, nested INDEX/MATCH, LET, LAMBDA
ETL data hygiene: cleaning and unpivoting trial balances in Power Query
3-statement integrated dynamic financial modeling & DCF cash flow forecasting
Executive KPI dashboard engineering with Slicers & Scenario Manager
checklists: Implement advanced formula architecture: dynamic arrays, XLOOKUP, nested INDEX/MATCH, LET, and LAMBDA
Execute automated ETL data cleaning and unpivot messy trial balances using Power Query
Construct 3-statement integrated dynamic financial models with dynamic cash flow projections
Perform sensitivity analysis using Pivot Tables, Slicers, What-If Analysis, Goal Seek, and Scenario Manager
Engineer executive financial KPI dashboards for working capital monitoring and debt covenant tracking
nodes.description: Advanced financial modeling, automated data cleansing pipelines, and corporate dashboard design. Focuses on dynamic spreadsheet engineering, Power Query ETL pipelines, multi-statement integrated corporate forecasting, and executive dashboard presentation.

stages.title: Professional Level Practical Workshops
stages.subtitle: Analytics, cybersecurity governance & banking IS audit interrogation (3 Labs)

nodes.name: Business Intelligence & AI Analytics in Business
competencies: Multi-criteria decision matrix construction with weighted scoring models
Big data ingestion (>1M rows) using DirectQuery and star-schema dimensional modeling
Interactive BI visual dashboards with multi-tier drilldowns and heatmaps
AI-driven automated time-series decomposition and anomaly detection
checklists: Construct multi-criteria decision matrices with weighted commercial scoring models
Connect Power BI and Tableau to relational and warehouse databases with DirectQuery
Ingest and model big data datasets (>1M records) using star-schema dimensional architecture
Build interactive visual dashboards featuring cross-filtering, drill-through paths, and trend heatmaps
Apply AI-driven automated time-series decomposition, anomaly detection, and predictive forecasting visuals
nodes.description: Corporate decision support, big data modeling, and automated machine learning insights for financial executives. Covers multi-source ETL, star-schema data modeling in Power BI/Tableau, and AI-assisted financial anomaly detection.

nodes.name: Information Systems Security & Digital Forensics
competencies: ISO/IEC 27001 control objectives mapping and compliance reporting
Cloud RBAC, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) & Least Privilege enforcement
SIEM log ingestion and anomalous egress threat detection alert engineering
Forensic disk imaging, chain-of-custody documentation & artifact recovery (Autopsy)
Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT) execution and remediation
checklists: Map ISO/IEC 27001 control objectives and assess organizational compliance using compliance software
Configure Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), MFA, and Least Privilege policies in AWS IAM and Azure AD
Establish perimeter defense with stateful firewall rules, NAT, and endpoint protection policies
Ingest event logs into Splunk/ELK and configure real-time alert rules for anomalous egress traffic
Execute bit-stream forensic imaging using FTK Imager while upholding strict chain-of-custody protocols
Perform forensic file triage and artifact extraction with Autopsy
Conduct vulnerability scanning using OpenVAS and compile an executive remediation plan
nodes.description: Enterprise cybersecurity defense, cloud access governance, SIEM surveillance, and digital forensics. Covers ISO 27001 compliance, cloud identity access management, SIEM intrusion detection, forensic disk imaging, and vulnerability management.

nodes.name: IS Audit Lab: Banking CAAT Scenarios
competencies: Core Banking System duplicate transaction scan matching Date, Account, and Amount
GL journal creation audit detecting Maker-Checker segregation bypasses
Dormant account reactivation surveillance followed by high-value cash withdrawals
Automated independent compound interest recalculation against CBS engines
Segregation of Duties (SOD) matrix mapping for conflicting loan disbursement roles
AML velocity surge analysis flagging rapid structuring below CTR reporting limits
Audit of midnight/off-hours privileged administrative logins to core databases
BACPS cheque clearing threshold tampering detection
checklists: Query Core Banking System transaction logs to flag duplicate entries matching Date, Account Number, and Amount
Interrogate GL journal logs to identify Maker-Checker segregation bypasses where Maker_ID equals Checker_ID
Filter dormant account reactivation records followed by significant cash withdrawals or wires within 48 hours
Run independent automated compound interest recalculations via Python/SQL to verify CBS calculations
Audit user entitlement matrices to detect Segregation of Duties (SOD) conflicts in credit and disbursement roles
Analyze transaction velocity to flag AML structuring patterns just below Bangladesh Bank CTR thresholds
Audit timestamped database audit trails for unauthorized off-hours/midnight privileged administrator logins
Audit BACPS cheque clearing transaction batches for manager limit overrides
nodes.description: Real-world Computer-Assisted Audit Techniques (CAATs) executed against banking system databases aligned with ISACA CISA guidelines and Bangladesh Bank ICT security standards.
